release.changelog: First release. Point the camera at a component, tap, and the part number comes back on the screen with one short line saying what the part is. Needs the camera module in the LEFT slot. No credentials are compiled in; the wifi password and the API key go in over ESP-Iris RPC at runtime, or through the setup portal the board raises on its own access point. Every query also reports what it cost in bytes, milliseconds and tokens.
